_comment: P25 Commit 7 runtime A/B — ReoptimizationPeriod sweep. Goal: measure how the reoptimization period (and the compare-and-keep it triggers every period-th interval) affects average SP and per-activation scheduler runtime, against BF (brute-force ceiling) and INCR_SCRATCH (always-reopt, amnesiac control). Schedulers: BF, INCR_P1, INCR_P10, INCR_P30, INCR_P60, INCR_SCRATCH. The INCR_P<n> arms are plain INCR with GlobalVariables::ReoptimizationPeriod overridden to n at binary startup (RunOrchestrator.cpp parses the suffix from the mode string); the orchestrator dispatches them identically to INCR. INCR_P1 = reopt every interval, wide radius, compare-and-keep against the running incumbent (the always-reopt-with-memory upper bound). INCR_SCRATCH = reopt every interval but amnesiac (fresh optimizer each interval → RM+min-TL baseline each call, no carried incumbent). P10/P30/P60 show priority drift vs. reopt frequency. The period-0 'off' baseline is NOT included — Commit 6 made ReoptimizationPeriod positive-only (min 1). Use: MODE=prod CONFIG_JSON=simulation_experiments/configs/p25_period_ab_config.json ./scripts/run_end_to_end.sh. Note: the release binary must be rebuilt after Commit 6 (the dispatcher Optimize_w_TL_ScratchOrIncre must be linked in, else ReoptimizationPeriod is dead config).
_comment_on_naming: All keys use full descriptive names, mirroring experiment_config.json. Times are in seconds unless noted.

test_mode._comment: Fast smoke: 1 taskset, 70s, N=6 only, all six arms. Validates that INCR_P<n> modes run end-to-end and produce interval_sp_metrics + scheduler_execution_time before launching the full A/B.

prod_mode._comment: Full A/B: 5 random tasksets per task count, N={4,6,8}, 300s @ interval 10s (~30 scheduling triggers per run). base_random_seed=1000 so tasksets are deterministic and comparable across arms. parallel_worker_processes=4 (one arm per worker within a taskset; arms are independent).

plotting._comment: Publication-quality figure styling parameters (same defaults as experiment_config.json).

analysis._comment: Parameters controlling metric computation and data filtering (same defaults as experiment_config.json). enable_resume_from_existing_results=true so a partial A/B run can be resumed by re-invoking the same command.
